verdict.rationale: Remote ships an official MCP server, so a user can ask an AI client questions like "How many people do we have in Portugal?" and get answers from live Remote data. It also ships agent skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Gemini CLI that are driven by natural-language prompts. However, the natural-language layer depends on an external AI client, and documented write actions are limited to employee self-service. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, broader write coverage beyond employee self-service (admin, payroll and hiring actions), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: It reads the question, fetches the answer from Remote through the MCP, and replies from your live data.
Write tools (employee self-service, available today): Submit time off requests; Update personal details, home address, emergency contact
The plugin works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
